sights.n: Pinaisara Falls, Iriomote (ピナイサーラの滝)
sights.w: Okinawa Prefecture's highest waterfall — a 54 m drop on the Hinai River, reached by kayaking the Hinai mangroves and a jungle trail inside Iriomote-Ishigaki National Park.

sights.n: Urauchi River & Mariyudu Falls, Iriomote (浦内川・マリユドゥの滝)
sights.w: Okinawa's longest river: a boat cruise up the mangrove-lined Urauchi, then a jungle walk to Mariyudu Falls, a two-tier fall selected among Japan's 100 best waterfalls.
sights.k: River cruise to a top-100 waterfall

sights.n: Cape Hirakubo & lighthouse, Ishigaki (平久保崎)
sights.w: The northern tip of Ishigaki's Hirakubo Peninsula; from the white lighthouse the Pacific lies on one side and the East China Sea on the other.
Cliff-top cape at Yonaguni's eastern end, grazed by Yonaguni horses, with views across to Iriomote on clear days.

sights.n: Kondoi Beach, Taketomi Island (コンドイ浜)
sights.w: Taketomi's west-coast swimming beach: white sand and a long, shallow emerald lagoon calm enough for small children; reached by rental bicycle from the village.
